COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
WPCRL No. 920 of 2025
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Shivam Gulati, learned counsel for the Petitioner
through video conferencing. 
2. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned A.G.A. assisted by Mr. Prabhat 
Kandpal, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand. 
3. The present Criminal Writ Petition, filed under Article 226 
of the Constitution of India, has been filed with the following 
prayer:-
“(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari 
quashing the impugned FIR No. 0567 dated 20.08.2025, U/s 
127(2) and 140(3) of B.N.S.2023, lodged at P.S. Kotwali 
Haridwar, District Haridar.”
4. The Petitioner has also filed a Stay Application, seeking a 
stay on the arrest of the Petitioner, pursuant to the impugned 
FIR No. 0567 of 2025 dated 20.08.2025, U/s 127(2) and 140(3) 
of B.N.S., 2023 lodged at P.S. Kotwali, Haridwar, District 
Haridwar. 
5. Admit.
6. Issue notice to Respondent No. 3.
7. Steps to be taken within a week. 
8. Let the objections be filed by the Respondents.
9. List this case on 13.10.2025.
10. As an interim measure, it is directed that, till the next 
date of listing, no coercive measures shall be taken against the 
Petitioner pursuant to the impugned FIR No. 0567 of 2025, 
provided he cooperates with the investigation. In case of non￾cooperation, the interim relief so granted shall stand 
automatically vacated.
11. The Stay Application stands disposed of accordingly.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 01.09.2025
Shiksha

with
WPCRLNo. 920 of 2025
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Lalit Sharma learned counsel for
the petitioner in WPCRL NO. 1564 of 2025. 
2. Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned A.G.A for 
the State.
3. The petitioner of WPCRL No. 920 of 
2025 is present in Court who was granted 
interim protection by the Coordinate Bench 
in a reference to FIR dated 20.08.2025 bearing 
FIR No. 0567 of 2025.
4. Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned A.G.A 
apprise to this Court that recently a dead 
body is recovered and a sample has been 
taken for DNA Analysis and report is 
awaited. He also apprise to this Court that 
on the previous occasion petitioner was 
asked to polygraph test but his family 
members were not agree. 
5. Now, the petitioner is present in Court 
and submits that he is ready for polygraphic
test.
6. Let the same be carried out by the 
Investigating Agency within a week and 
submit a report of polygraphic test on the  next date fixed.
7. List this case on 27.04.2026. Till then, 
the interim order shall continue in WPCRL 
No. 920 of 2025. The petitioner shall not leave 
the District Haridwar, and will cooperate 
with the investigation. 
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 
17.04.2026
Nahid
